description: Download the shipping label of a shipment as an embedded PDF resource (Logistics API downloadLabelFile). Pass the shipmentId from ebay_create_shipment_from_shipping_quote. Logistics API is limited release (eBay-approved developers only, USPS rates and labels only) and needs the https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.logistics scope, which is not requested by default: eligible keysets add it to EBAY_OAUTH_SCOPES and re-consent.
name: ebay_download_shipping_label_file
